visual.general_description: Line chart of CRP over days following presentation with vertical lines labelled by antibiotic regimen changes.
visual.detailed_description: Line chart on a white background with a thick blue line joining 21 round markers. The y axis is titled CRP (mg/L), runs from 0 to 250 with light horizontal gridlines every 50, and the x axis is titled Days following presentation with tick labels 0, 4, 8, 11, 18, 19, 21, 24, 26, 29, 30, 31, 32, 35, 46, 60, 67, 81, 85, 100 and 109. The line starts near 37, rises to about 87 at day 4, falls to the 20s to 30s through day 24 with a bump near 55 at day 19, stays near 17 at day 26, jumps to about 213 at day 29, then falls steadily to about 26 by day 35 and to single digits and low values thereafter. Eight thin black vertical lines carry rotated bold labels reading: IV ceftriaxone; IV ceftriaxone + metronidazole; IV meropenem + vancomycin; IV ceftriaxone, PO linezolid, PO metronidazole; IV co-amoxiclav, PO metronidazole; IV vancomycin + meropenem; IV vancomycin, meropenem, teicoplanin; IV teicoplanin + ertapenem (to continue for 6 weeks).
